claims.text: Correct nutritional deficiencies (eg, of thiamin or vitamin B12), and give good nutrition and hydration, along with correcting the cause and stopping exacerbating medications
claims.quote: Correcting the cause (eg, treating infection, giving fluids and electrolytes for dehydration) and removing exacerbating factors (eg, stopping medications) may result in resolution of delirium. Nutritional deficiencies (eg, of thiamin or vitamin B12) should be corrected, and good nutrition and hydration should be provided.
